# Culture
The Trans-Solarian Federation, originally a semi-peaceful, powerless puppet government known as "the Confederacy," rose to power after the corporate war between NanoTrasen and the Syndicate. After NT lost its grip on the government and the galaxy, the very name became seen as a blight on society, and megacorporations were seen as something inherently evil. The military confiscated NT technology from their warehouses and enacted laws to ensure that no company would ever grow so large it controlled the government. Within a century, they had changed from a relatively benign democracy into a fascist dictatorship with a wide-spanning military that covered more than half the galaxy. This shift in ideology ultimately resulted in the USSP workers union revolting, the official reorganization and rebranding into the TSF, and the start of a long civil war that made the Sol sector largely uninhabitable.
The culture saw a massive shift too. Large gaps formed between the elite rich that controlled the government and the everyday citizen barely making ends meet. Companies flourished under direct governmental oversight, with weapons manufacturers gaining the biggest grants and priviledges. Knowing your place in society, adhering to the law, and obeying your superior became an expectation of every Federation citizen.
Caligo Prime, TSF's new capitol, became an idyllic paradise for the rich and the citizens supporting their lifestyle. Any sense of disorder or uncleanliness was swept beneath the surface, with this disparity becoming extremely apparent further out from the Caligo system. Competitive sports and military backed TV events became a common household entertainment for citizens unable to travel far from their home or the workplace. Military propaganda programs meant to inspire loyalty and patriotism was regularly blasted on government controlled media. Billboards and posters to support the TSF and its military lined every major street and workplace. Though there was rebellious sentiment throughout Federation space, it was easily quashed.
In the wake of the TSF and USSP civil war, funding shifted massively towards the already largely funded Navy and Marine Corps. The TSF became even more aggressive than usual, leading to them fighting multiple wars at once and spreading their forces thin in some sectors. This has left the Colossus sector in particular unable to receive reinforcements in a timely manner to support what the Federation considers a local war against the PDV.
The TSF is led by a President, who on the surface is elected by public vote. However the requirements to run require extensive military service, making most candidates veteran loyalists favored by the regime. These elections tend to be month long events of expensive military parades, competitive events designed to showcase military skill, speeches, and the occasional public execution of terrorists, POWs, and death row criminals broadcast across the Federation. These presidential candidates tend to be closely followed by Winter Solstice units.
Winter Solstice, while typically considered synonymous with TSF High Command, is actually a specialist division within and has the authority to grant itself access to any operation and unit it sees fit to. In addition to largely controlling the military, it also has massive influence over the civilian side of the government. Members of WS are fanatically loyal, handpicked from the military either on merit and skill, or connections. Not every high level officer is a member of WS, but those who are carry more authority outside the typical chain of command. It is considered a great honor to be in the presence of Winter Solstice officers and their spec ops protection units, though their presence often inspires fear in the common civilian and even soldier.
